title: Extract validation helpers into their own module
prompt: src/handlers.ts mixes HTTP handlers with input validation. Move isEmail, isStrongPassword and validateSignup into a new src/validation.ts (exported from there), import them in src/handlers.ts, and make src/admin.ts import them from src/validation.ts too instead of duplicating isEmail. Behaviour must not change. src/handlers.ts must no longer define any of those functions.
